authored_source_ids: r000 through r127, R16 contains every eighth item starting with r000
external_roles: Sort undistorted DSLR file names by UTF-8 bytes. H takes zero-indexed floor((2*j+1)*N/20) for j=0..9. Retain every other actual image as R=A.
access: One signed frame per checkpoint. R=A for the clean study. The source broker gives training and scoring only source images plus allowed target camera metadata. Register H roles before opening source imagery. Source-only known-pose matching and triangulation. No evaluation or initialization from full-photo points, tracks, scan, colours or depth. Freeze all confirmation terminal predictions and risk outputs before opening any confirmation target observation.

upstream.photometry: native target projected display-sRGB, expected camera-Z and opacity; keep raw shots, frame transform and exact output digests
upstream.selection: one uniform source-only recipe; freeze schedule, registered native controls and remaining total budget at the end of development

source_selection.alias: Clamp to the real inventory and evaluate a repeated ordered set once. Count actual observations read.
source_selection.full_audit: explicit separate cost; never include full-bank features in finite-budget head or P2

head.penalty: lambda/2 times squared standardized coefficients, intercept excluded, normalized row weights
head.standardization: weighted training-only finite means and population standard deviations; mean-impute, scale constant columns by 1
head.sample_unit: stable per-family/condition/view permutation of available labelled pixel identities. Retain the same identities at every unique coverage K. In each family/condition/view give every retained physical pixel equal total weight across its available K rows; give the planned units equal mass.
head.selection: Three deterministic candidates and one deterministic final refit of the selected penalty on the same original training sample; exact numerical independent recomputation. Tie on development loss selects larger penalty. No external pixels in the fit.

labels.domain: all independent reference-finite central crop pixels; count missing or invalid predictions separately
labels.event: mean absolute difference of three display-sRGB channels in FP32 strictly greater than FP32(0.05)

development_selection: K16 and common finite labelled domain of the candidates and the three simple rules, per-target floor 20% lowest risk, row-major tie. Equal target then checkpoint then scene weights on b04 and delivery_area; require each scene. Select the lowest error among simple rules, tie order coverage, alpha_missing, residual. Select candidate separately using the same endpoint. No further selection on confirmation.
p1: G numerator = labelled correct AND Q has no comparable source AND an independently costed complete A audit has a comparable source, denominator all labelled correct in that target. If full bank cannot be audited or denominator zero, use NA. Delta G for coverage Q4 minus fixed Q4; negative favours coverage. Separately report coverage Q16 versus coverage Q4.
p2: K16 coverage, same actual Q and bounded observed features. Score on pairwise common finite labelled positions of the new head and the frozen simple rule. Accept floor(0.2*C) lowest ranks per view, tie by ascending row-major position. Report both errors and denominator, C, full reference count, quota/full share. Equal targets then checkpoints then scenes. Both external scene deltas must be strictly negative for limited support; ties or worse are mixed/negative if the full experiment ran.
secondary: For each method and actual K report own and shared domains, positive counts, AP using whole score ties, both 10% and 20% low-error acceptance and high-error capture, risk-coverage curve, unknown reasons. Shared Q4 head comparisons hold sources and predictions fixed. P1 source-gap integrity has independent authored geometry evaluation. Show two external scenes separately, no pixel bootstrap.
undefined: No positive labels gives null AP with explicit reason. Empty finite domain or quota less than one gives null rate. A missing view has its full planned reference denominator and explicit terminal status. A fit or confirmation gap that prevents primary measurement stays blocked or incomplete. Report upstream degeneracy diagnostics even if P2 is calculable.
view_proxy: For each external scene and method at K16, rank its ten targets by the mean of the highest ceil(10% of finite scores), descending. A fully unscorable target has priority before all scored targets. Resolve ties by larger unknown fraction then ascending target ID. Open exactly 2. Report captured, missed and total RGB errors plus ranking costs.
humanities_case: All authored bell h-equivalent six original views; B fixed case b05-perforated-gallery / R128 / h00, include every available K regardless of change. Identical target prediction hash at each budget.
scope: An off-line static source audit with two external confirmation scenes and two authored confirmation families. Zero DINO fine-tunes, zero calibration fits and zero active-camera experiments.
